title: Is footage from Indian homes going abroad to train robots? MeitY questions Pronto and other platforms
summary:
MeitY has questioned Pronto, Urban Company and Snabbit over footage recorded inside Indian homes, asking whether companies share it with overseas AI developers and how they obtain consent and protect privacy.

The post Is footage from Indian homes going abroad to train robots? MeitY questions Pronto and other platforms appeared first on MEDIANAMA.
llm_summary: India’s Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology has called out platforms such as Pronto, Urban Company and Snabbit, asking them to clarify whether video footage captured inside users’ homes is being shared with overseas AI developers for robot‑training purposes. The ministry wants to know how these companies obtain consent, safeguard privacy and comply with data‑protection rules before any such data is transferred abroad.
